title: SceneAgent: A Multi-Agent Framework for Portable Game Scene Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.17821v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Moving a scene generator to a new game engine requires more than exporting its final output: planning, construction tools, and stored experience may also depend on the original backend. We present SceneAgent, a multi-agent framework for reusing the construction process and its experience across backends. A canonical SceneContext maintains the evolving world, while backend adapters isolate coordinate conventions, asset bindings, and export. Structured handoffs let fresh Builder sessions query this persistent state without inheriting the full construction transcript. Across generations, human-approved traces are distilled into asset-ID-free Layout skills and semantic Content skills that can be retrieved and recombined. We introduce GameSceneBench, comprising 69 indoor and outdoor prompts. Under a common asset and evaluation protocol, SceneAgent obtains human tie-adjusted preference scores of 78.2-89.4% against five baselines. Ablations s

translated_title: SceneAgent：一种面向可移植游戏场景生成的多智能体框架
translated_abstract: 将场景生成器迁移到新的游戏引擎时，仅仅导出其最终输出是不够的：规划、构建工具以及存储的经验可能都依赖于原始的后端。我们提出了SceneAgent，这是一个用于跨后端复用构建过程及其经验的多智能体框架。一个规范化的SceneContext维护着不断演进的世界状态，而后端适配器则将坐标系约定、资产绑定和导出操作隔离开来。通过结构化的交接机制，新的Builder会话可以查询这一持久状态，而无需继承完整的构建记录。在跨代际的生成过程中，经过人工批准的构建轨迹会被提炼成不含资产ID的布局技能和语义化的内容技能，这些技能可以被检索和重新组合。我们推出了GameSceneBench，包含69个室内和室外场景提示。在统一的资产和评估协议下，SceneAgent与五个基线相比获得了78.2%-89.4%的人工平局调整偏好分数。
tldr: SceneAgent是一个多智能体框架，通过规范的场景上下文、后端适配器以及从人工批准轨迹中提炼的可复用技能，实现了游戏场景构建过程与经验在不同游戏引擎后端间的跨平台迁移复用。
